description: This is a PHP unit test file for the ClaimDao class within the Claim module of the OrangeHRM project. It tests methods like getClaimRequestById and getClaimRequestList to verify data retrieval functionalities.

classes.name: ClaimDaoRequestTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing ClaimDao functions related to claim requests in the OrangeHRM application.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, including creating an instance of ClaimDao and populating test data fixtures.

methods.name: testGetClaimRequestById

methods.name: testGetClaimRequestList
methods.description: Tests that getClaimRequestList returns the expected number of claim requests based on search filter parameters.
